general.intro: Configure interface language and startup behavior.

appearance.intro: Customize theme, animations, interface scale, and terminal font.
appearance.themeHint: With the system, it follows the computer's light and dark
appearance.motionHint: Disable UI transitions and motion loops for deterministic UI testing or reduced motion.
appearance.scaleHint: Scales the whole workbench; the farm keeps its whole-number scaling
appearance.monoFontHint: Monospace font for terminals, diffs, and file previews, with built-in Nerd Font icon fallback
appearance.terminalFontSizeHint: Also adjustable anytime in the terminal view with ⌘+ / ⌘- / ⌘0
appearance.previewNote: Updates live with scale, font, and terminal size

profile.intro: Customize your display name, tagline, and avatar shown in the rail and dashboard.
profile.displayNameHint: Shown on your dashboard and profile card
profile.taglineHint: A short bio or focus note
profile.avatarHint: Upload a custom image or pick a Papertrails preset

mcp.intro: Connect VibeValley as an MCP server into your local coding agents with one click or copyable snippets.
mcp.transportHint: stdio launches the local CLI process (full access); streamableHttp connects to the running server /mcp endpoint

data.intro: Inspect local data paths, repository and worktree folders, and the active storage backend.
data.backendHint: Storage backend for attachments, media inputs, and notes

models.intro: Configure model accounts, API keys, and feature bindings.
models.deepseekHint: The assistant and VibeValley's own helpers use it

memory.intro: Helpers can also look things up in, and write to, memory outside VibeValley.

about.intro: Inspect server version, desktop auto-update status, and CLI installation.
about.settingsHint: The keys and these pages' settings
about.reposHint: The space's repos; each folder is a git repository
about.worktreesHint: Each issue's own checkout while a helper works
about.updateHint: The desktop app updates itself from GitHub releases
about.disabled: Auto-update is off in dev builds
about.readyNewFarm: Version {next} is ready: starts fresh and keeps previous data aside

manual.diskImage: {next} must be installed manually: the app is running from its disk image; drag it to Applications first
manual.translocated: {next} must be installed manually: macOS launched it from a temporary location; drag it to Applications and reopen
manual.readOnly: {next} must be installed manually: the app's folder is not writable
manual.noBuild: {next} has no build for this Mac

failedKind.network: Network error while checking or downloading the update
failedKind.rateLimit: GitHub rate limit reached; try again shortly
failedKind.integrity: Download integrity check failed; retry or download manually
failedKind.signature: App signature verification failed; download from the release page
failedKind.permission: No permission to replace the app; check folder permissions or install manually
failedKind.install: Could not install the update; retry or download manually

about.workingQuestion: {n} active sessions are running; restarting will interrupt them. Restart now?
about.newFarmQuestion: The new version starts from fresh data; the old stays in the home folder. Restart now?
about.cliHint: Once installed, {command} reads and writes this farm from a terminal, for agents on this Mac too
about.cliReady: Use {command} in a terminal; agents on this Mac can read and write this farm with it
about.cliNotOnPath: Installed at {link}, but ~/.local/bin is not on your PATH: add export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" to ~/.zshrc
about.cliTaken: {link} is another program's file and was not replaced: move it away, then install

missing.mossKey: The MOSS account has no key yet
missing.mossOff: The MOSS account it uses is turned off
missing.binding: No account and model chosen for it yet

remote.toggleHint: Allow paired devices to connect to this Mac over Tailscale.
